endpoints.name: SearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple partner fields (name, description, etc.). This endpoint allows searching partners by `searchText` across name, description, and other basic fields. For more advanced, structured searches, use the `AdvancedSearchPartners` endpoint.

Find partners containing 'Government'
Search for partners with 'Development' in description
Look for partners with specific keywords
Find partner by short name or acronym
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple name, description, or basic field searches. NOT for complex criteria or relationship searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including status, dates, relationships, and complex filters. This endpoint supports complex, structured searches using the `searchCriteria` parameter. `searchCriteria` should be a JSON array of objects, where each object has `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. Multiple criteria can be combined using `logicalOperator` (e.g., 'and', 'or'). Available fields for search include: `id`, `name`, `status`, `partnerShortDescription`, `partnerLongDescription`, `partnerCategoryId`, `liaisonOfficeId`, `partnerFocalPointUserId`, `partnerGroupCode`, `erpDimValue`, `unAndStateEntity`, `keyGlobalPartner`, `unSecretariatPartner`, `dueDiligenceRequired`, `dueDiligenceApproval`, `dueDiligenceApprovalDate`, `dueDiligenceExpiryDate`, `partnerApprovalStatus`, `partnerApprovalDate`, `partnerApprovalReference`, `partnerApprovedBy`, `partnerLevyStatus`, `reasonForLevy`, `levyTreatment`, `pooledFund`, `canCreateNewOpportunities`, `reasonForNoNewOpportunity`, `createdDate`, `lastModifiedDate`, `createdBy`, `lastModifiedBy`, `isDeleted`. Available operators are: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields (`createdDate`, `modifiedDate`) support date-specific operators like `between`, `on`, `this week`, etc. Example usage: `[{"field":"status","operator":"is","value":"Active"},{"field":"createdDate","operator":"between","value":"2023-01-01,2023-12-31","logicalOperator":"and"}]`

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Find active government partners
Show partners with global key account status
Get partners created this month
Find partners by status and office location
List partners involved in climate projects
Search for partners by complex criteria combinations
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner status, dates, types, complex criteria, or multiple field combinations.
